rationale: A stablecoin issuer cost model can appear to improve solely because the adjusted definition changes. Updating both bases, deriving nine-month comparisons and reconciling two different margin denominators produces an actionable research artifact without inventing an interest-rate attribution.
exposure: Reference/control verification only, no candidate-model exposure
reference_method: Independent Python Decimal calculations from source facts, separate from submitted SQL
candidate_view_review: Source headings, signs, periods and relevant definitions directly inspected before model exposure

contract_revision.changes: Explicit input database, output directory and existing basename restriction

grading_correction.changes: Correct SBC source bindings and accept known dossier context with sufficient support. No financial, source, SQL or counterfactual changes.

quality_revision.evidence: Reviewed per-output support and additional context, unrelated sections rejected

replacement_review.assertion: Reserve-yield changes contributed more than half of the FY2024-to-FY2025 change in reserve income.
replacement_review.source_grounded_reason: The supplied operations provide annual reserve income. The definitions state that yield and average circulation both affect reserve income, but do not provide the separate constant-balance rate contribution needed to decide this causal majority claim.
